text:
viv_fin: Heads up - nightly allocation checker raised a $7,650 unallocated GPU bill in secondary region (asia-south) between 03:40-05:20 UTC. alert: https://billing.redwood.example/alerts/2487654321 :warning:
maya_ops: digging in. I see a cluster failover last night that routed jobs to asia-south. Many VMs show `region=asia-south` but missing `team` and `cost_center` tags.
trent_infra: we ran a maintenance migration for cross-region DR; migration script omitted tag propagation for preemptible nodes. That explains the missing labels. My bad.
cloud-cost-bot: [auto] untagged_gpu_burst cluster=asia-south-gpu amount_usd=7650 window=2026-03-23T03:40:00Z->2026-03-23T05:20:00Z
lucia_sales: could be customer-facing. Which namespaces map to paying customers vs internal perf jobs? need estimate before EOD so AMs can prepare.
maya_ops: quick namespace -> customer join: `models-prod` ~ $4.1k, `perf-eval` ~ $1.8k, `dev-sandbox` ~ $0.9k, unknown ~ $0.85k. I'll produce a CSV.
viv_fin: finance prefers a manual-adjustment CSV with fields: instance_id, orig_ingest_id, start_ts, end_ts, est_cost_usd, tentative_account. Put it in /internal/finance/billing_reconciliations/2487654321-asia-south-migration-backfill.csv and tag rows `manual_attribution`.
trent_infra: will also publish a patch to the migration tool to copy tags and add a preflight check. I'll open PR and include a safelist to reject node bring-up without cost tags.
maya_ops: backfill script running; ETA ~25m. Note: avoid reprocessing the billing pipeline until finance confirms to prevent double-charges.
lucia_sales: I'll notify AMs for accounts in `models-prod` and `perf-eval` so they can expect a short billing note.
viv_fin: cloud-cost-bot created ticket #BILL-8749 for tracking. Once CSV uploaded, finance will ingest manual adjustments and send a brief customer message if needed. I'll follow up with a short incident note. :thumbsup:
trent_infra: PR for migration tag-copy and reject-rule coming up.
maya_ops: CSV uploaded and linked in ticket. marking rows with `manual_attribution` and including original ingest ids.
viv_fin: thanks all — will close this thread after ingestion and confirmation to AMs.
